oliver: :rotating_light: Observed increased TLS handshake failures from edge-proxy -> internal services in ap-south-1 after we rolled the new 'strict-tls' policy at 03:00 UTC. Failures correlate with services behind envoy-proxy. Logs show `ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert protocol version` and `no shared cipher` in some cases.
marta: Which services? can we triage service-by-service or is it widespread?
oliver: Primarily: auth, routing, embeddings-cache. Not all instances, looks like older VMs still running legacy OpenSSL or older envoy builds.
raj: Seen similar in staging when we disabled TLS1.2+ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256. Envoy config snippet we pushed:```yaml
tls_context:
  common_tls_context:
    tls_params:
      tls_minimum_protocol_version: TLSv1_3
      cipher_suites: "TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256"
```
emma: Logs from auth show: `SSL handshake failed: error:141A318A:SSL routines:tls_process_ske_dhe:wrong signature type`. Could be mismatched key types or RSA-only client. Also seeing KMS decrypt latency spikes for some auth tokens around same time.
sylvie: @raj can envoy talk to services that only support RSA key exchange? we may need fallback ciphers or a canary rollback.
raj: Envoy supports fallback but we intentionally removed RSA-based suites for forward secrecy. Quick options: (1) roll back policy in ap-south-1 only, (2) add a small set of RSA-compatible ciphers back for a short window while we patch clients, (3) upgrade the older instances.
oliver: We need audit evidence for any rollback decision (compliance wants timeline + RBAC approvals). Can we gate rollbacks behind an approval in the security channel and log the event to the auditbus?
emma: For KMS part: the decrypt latency spikes are from regional KMS path hitting a throttling edge, some retries pushed client libs to older cipher suites? unclear. I filed a KMS ticket (KMS-4772) and added correlation IDs from logs: `cid=ap-south-1:ef12`.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: `rollback-strict-tls-ap-south-1` (PR #4321). Canary on 2 nodes first, then pause for 15m, then full rollback if pass.
marta: Suggestion: perform a targeted rollback for routing & auth first, keep embeddings-cache on strict for now. That reduces blast radius. Also add handshake debug logging: `envoy --tls-debug` and enable handshake audit logs to S3 with lifecycle 90d.
raj: I'll prepare a patch to reintroduce `TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256` temporarily and add a connection metric `tls_negotiation_success{service,region,cipher}`.
sylvie: For RBAC/audit: I'll add an entry to the change control ticket summarizing approvers (sec on-call + service owners), timestamp, and attach the rollback PR. Compliance needs the action and justification.
oliver: Action items: 1) raj do targeted rollback patch + canary (ETA 18m). 2) emma correlate KMS ticket and share decrypt traces (ETA 30m). 3) marta run quick inventory of envoy/OpenSSL versions in ap-south-1 and mark nodes needing upgrade. 4) sylvie record approvals and enable handshake audit logs. If anyone objects to rollback, speak now.
raj: starting canary now. Will post results.
emma: I'll push KMS traces to the ticket.
oliver: Thanks. Marking severity P1 until canary completes. Keep logs and any new handshake errors verbatim in this thread.
